name: Hollow-Shelf Leviathan

Traits.name: Shelf Mimicry
Traits.text: While the leviathan remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from the frozen shelf it waits beneath.
Traits.gmQuote: something enormous and patient under the ice
Traits.expresses: ice-plated, spine-studded hide that mimics the lake's underside

Traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
Traits.text: If the leviathan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The leviathan makes three Spine attacks.

Actions.name: Spine
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 15 ft. 17 (2d8 + 8) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Cold damage.

Actions.name: Shelf Breach (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 22, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation. *Failure:* The target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn.
Actions.clause: The leviathan erupts from directly beneath a surface it is hidden under. Each creature standing above it must make a Dex
Actions.expresses: ambushing from directly beneath the frozen surface

Bonus Actions.name: Shadow Hide
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the leviathan takes the Hide action.

Legendary Actions.name: Legendary Action Uses: 3
Legendary Actions.text: Immediately after another creature's turn, the leviathan can expend a use to take one of the following actions. It regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

Legendary Actions.name: Ice Glide
Legendary Actions.text: The leviathan moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Spine attack.

Legendary Actions.name: Sink Below
Legendary Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the leviathan takes the Hide action. The leviathan can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Legendary Actions.name: Terror Glare
Legendary Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 22, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

lore: An ancient glacier-beast that grew too heavy for the surface, it sank beneath the winter lake and learned to become the ice itself, keeping a hoard of frozen carcasses beneath its resting place.
